t: 法国与西班牙签订《努瓦永条约》。法国的弗朗索瓦一世承认查理对那不勒斯的主权，神圣罗马帝国皇帝查…
te: The Treaty of Noyon between France and Spain is signed. Francis I of France recognizes Charles's claim to Naples, and C…
dz: 法国与西班牙签订《努瓦永条约》。法国的弗朗索瓦一世承认查理对那不勒斯的主权，神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理五世则承认弗朗西斯对米兰的主权。
de: The Treaty of Noyon between France and Spain is signed. Francis I of France recognizes Charles's claim to Naples, and Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor, recognizes Francis's claim to Milan.

t: 英国入侵法国始于英国国王亨利五世在法国登陆.
te: The English invasion of France begins when English king Henry V lands in France.
dz: 英国入侵法国始于英国国王亨利五世在法国登陆.
de: The English invasion of France begins when English king Henry V lands in France.

t: 教皇乌尔班二世于上个月去世后选举教皇帕斯卡尔二世。
te: Election of Pope Paschal II following the death of pope Urban II in the previous month.
dz: 教皇乌尔班二世于上个月去世后选举教皇帕斯卡尔二世。
de: Election of Pope Paschal II following the death of pope Urban II in the previous month.

t: 海诺的雷吉纳一世伯爵起而反对洛特哈林吉亚的克文蒂博德并杀死了近现代的苏斯特伦.
te: Count Reginar I of Hainault rises against Zwentibold of Lotharingia and slays him near present-day Susteren.
dz: 海诺的雷吉纳一世伯爵起而反对洛特哈林吉亚的克文蒂博德并杀死了近现代的苏斯特伦.
de: Count Reginar I of Hainault rises against Zwentibold of Lotharingia and slays him near present-day Susteren.

t: 意大利皇帝路易二世和皇后恩格尔贝加被贝内文托亲王阿德尔奇斯所俘.
te: Emperor Louis II of Italy and Empress Engelberga are captured by Prince Adelchis of Benevento.
dz: 意大利皇帝路易二世和皇后恩格尔贝加被贝内文托亲王阿德尔奇斯所俘.
de: Emperor Louis II of Italy and Empress Engelberga are captured by Prince Adelchis of Benevento.

t: 莫里斯被垂死的皇帝提比略加冕为拜占庭帝国皇帝.
te: Maurice is crowned Emperor of the Byzantine Empire by the dying emperor Tiberius.
dz: 莫里斯被垂死的皇帝提比略加冕为拜占庭帝国皇帝.
de: Maurice is crowned Emperor of the Byzantine Empire by the dying emperor Tiberius.

t: 贾斯丁尼皇帝 我发布一个实用的 制裁,他在其中组织 更新罗马统治 最近重新征服的意大利。 在哥…
te: Emperor Justinian I issues a Pragmatic Sanction in which he organises the renewed Roman rule over the recently re-conqu…
dz: 贾斯丁尼皇帝 我发布一个实用的 制裁,他在其中组织 更新罗马统治 最近重新征服的意大利。 在哥特式统治下给予罗马人的所有特权直到538年得到确认,被没收的地产被恢复,罗马教会对民事政府的参与也有所增加.
de: Emperor Justinian I issues a Pragmatic Sanction in which he organises the renewed Roman rule over the recently re-conquered Italy. All privileges granted to Romans under the Gothic rule until 538 are confirmed, confiscated estates restored and the participation of the Roman Church in civil government increased.

t: 约翰一世在教宗霍米斯达斯去世后成为了新的教宗.
te: John I becomes the new Pope after the death of Pope Hormisdas.
dz: 约翰一世在教宗霍米斯达斯去世后成为了新的教宗.
de: John I becomes the new Pope after the death of Pope Hormisdas.

t: 屋大维在罗马举办了连续三次胜利中的第一个,以庆祝对达尔马提亚部落的胜利.
te: Octavian holds the first of three consecutive triumphs in Rome to celebrate the victory over the Dalmatian tribes.
dz: 屋大维在罗马举办了连续三次胜利中的第一个,以庆祝对达尔马提亚部落的胜利.
de: Octavian holds the first of three consecutive triumphs in Rome to celebrate the victory over the Dalmatian tribes.
